cohort: 773 women with placenta previa from two tertiary care hospitals in Guangdong, China, between January 2014 and December 2018
finding: History of caesarean delivery is associated with an increased risk of adverse maternal outcomes but not with neonatal outcomes in women with placenta previa.
mod_finding: This study compared maternal and neonatal outcomes between placenta previa cases with and without a history of cesarean delivery, focusing on the impact of prior cesarean section on outcomes.
